question:
(i) Explain how the force on a charge due to two other charges is calculated using Coulomb’s law and the principle of superposition.
(ii) Two equal forces each of magnitude $F$ act on a charge with an angle of $60^\circ$ between them. Find the magnitude of the resultant force.

options.A:
(i) Add the magnitudes of individual Coulomb forces directly, without considering their directions
(ii) Resultant force is $2F$
options.B:
(i) Add the charges first and apply Coulomb’s law once to the total charge
(ii) Resultant force is $\sqrt{2}F$
options.C:
(i) Calculate the Coulomb force due to each charge separately and add the force vectors using superposition
(ii) $R=\sqrt{F^2+F^2+2F^2\cos60^\circ}=\sqrt{3}F$
options.D:
(i) Only the force due to the nearest charge is considered
(ii) Resultant force is $F$
